title: Research: exact P104 port adapter for selected word
body:
## Result

This adds an exact `GL(9,2)` adapter from the selected word's 112 port masks to the E8 P112 labels and reindexes one admissible P104 frame-pair decoder onto the selected port set. The certificate checks the functional-weight identity for all 512 labels and verifies the bijection on all 112 ports.

The mapped puncture removes selected port values `145, 161, 22, 38, 280, 296, 431, 415` (positions `18, 20, 26, 27, 60, 63, 104, 107`). On the remaining 104 ports, the exact decoder satisfies `D T^T = 2G` entrywise and has eight term ranks `7`, for copy cost `56 = 7/13 * 104`. Restoring any one removed frame port leaves exactness but raises the decoder cost to 57.

## Selected-profile pricing

The package replays the PR717 P1 P104 knob against the current selected T37 profile with both exact moment engines and the pinned outer calculation. In that favorable model the complex lower bound rises by 5.5311%, above the fixed bit primitive; the outer result is capped at `κ = 0.001730427469823602`.

This is a scoped decoder construction, not a complete replacement supplier or new κ. The asymmetric-centre reads and construction, phase-frame legality and restoration, unpaired-centre parity costs, pair-split conflicts, and whole-call supplier integration remain unpriced. The selected record is unchanged.

## Relation to prior work

PR717 and PR968 provide the abstract E8 P104 decoder family. Open PR1619 prices the P104 puncture-depth knob but leaves a selected-word realization open. This PR supplies the exact selected-port relabeling and one reindexed decoder witness; it does not claim that the remaining local-word compiler obligations are solved.

## Reproduce

From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/selected-p104-port-adapter/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-p104-port-adapter --check-only
```

Expected verifier marker: `PASS_SELECTED_P104_PORT_ADAPTER: 512 exact weights; 112-port GL adapter; P104 104 ports; 8 terms rank 7; exact selected-profile knob price; no full supplier or new kappa`.

The exact base is `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`; source and engine pins are in `SOURCES.json`. The package includes adapter, decoder-corruption, and restored-port controls.

Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Predecessor attribution and source pins are recorded in `NOTICE.md` and `SOURCES.json`.
